questions.subject: general_test
questions.stem: In a class of 60 students, 35 play cricket, 28 play football and 10 play neither game. How many students play both games?
questions.explanation: Students who play at least one game are 60 − 10 = 50. By the set formula n(A ∪ B) = n(A) + n(B) − n(A ∩ B), we get 50 = 35 + 28 − n(A ∩ B), so n(A ∩ B) = 13.
